The *Sattakapuggalapaññatti* is a chapter of the *Puggalapaññatti*, the third book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Treating sets of seven types of persons, the text is referenced in connection with the *Udakūpamāsutta* (AN 7.15) of the Aṅguttara Nikāya and the *Accantaniyāmakathā* (Kv 19.7) of the *Kathāvatthu* [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral indexes two modern translations across two languages for this text [SuttaCentral].

Other chapters within the *Puggalapaññatti* also share significant material (such as Pp 2.4, Pp 2.1, Pp 2.3, Pp 2.9, and Pp 2.5), as do several other Nikāya divisions, including AN 5, AN 10, AN 4, AN 3, SN 16, SN 55, MN 68, and MN 70 [DharmaNexus].
